prompt:
Create a production-ready ORIGINAL game UI ICON ATLAS for OpenFA, a space colony strategy game. Supporting reference is our own new menu artwork: match its industrial teal/graphite metal and copper/amber accents only. Exactly 64 distinct symbols in an EXACT regular 8 columns by 8 rows square grid, each cell equally sized, uniform padding, all symbols centered. Actual transparent RGBA background. No text labels, no numbers, no captions, no cell borders, no complete buttons, no backgrounds, no ground, no buildings used as substitute icons. These are readable interface pictograms with subtle dimensional metallic shading and strong clean silhouettes, viewed straight on, NOT isometric. Each symbol occupies about 65 percent of its cell, with no spill into adjacent cells. Optimize readability when downsampled to 28x28 pixels. Use crisp light silver/cream silhouettes with small teal and amber accents, dark outline for legibility. Create original designs, no original Fragile Allegiance assets or logos. Cell order left to right, top to bottom:
1: strategic star map; 2: asteroid surface; 3: three-ship fleet; 4: single cargo ship inventory; 5: geological survey radar; 6: funds and stacked coins; 7: construction hammer and wrench; 8: construction grid; 9: sky and upward arrow; 10: colony database; 11: research flask and atom; 12: trade exchange arrows; 13: communications antenna; 14: personnel silhouette; 15: report document; 16: game control gear; 17: return back arrow; 18: confirm checkmark; 19: cancel X; 20: load folder arrow; 21: save memory disk; 22: delete waste bin; 23: settings sliders; 24: information letter i; 25: play triangle; 26: pause bars; 27: decrease minus; 28: increase plus; 29: zoom magnifier plus; 30: zoom magnifier minus; 31: previous left arrow; 32: next right arrow; 33: power lightning; 34: air fan; 35: food leaf; 36: water droplet; 37: population three people; 38: radiation trefoil; 39: ore crystal; 40: missile; 41: satellite; 42: shipyard gantry; 43: target crosshair; 44: center view cross; 45: lock closed; 46: lock open; 47: speaker volume; 48: speaker muted; 49: fullscreen corners; 50: window rectangles; 51: visual layers; 52: route waypoints; 53: launch upward spacecraft; 54: land downward spacecraft; 55: repair wrench; 56: demolition hammer; 57: new game sparkling star; 58: tutorial book; 59: multiplayer network; 60: quit power symbol; 61: language globe; 62: keyboard; 63: scroll up chevron; 64: scroll down chevron. Square high-resolution atlas, 2048x2048 if possible. Transparent pixels between every icon.
reference: Our generated source-menu.png only; no legacy artwork.
